issues.description: The Step 5 Stata program is supplied and named in the author run order, but the byte-first reader withheld its entire 316-line body. Step 6 documents and consumes distance_to_DOJ.dta by gvkey and uses chdis; the packaged product is readable. The exact Step 5 reads, active producer statement, join keys, fields, history and distance construction remain unreviewed. Static checklist paths base_zip.dta and gvkey_zip.dta cannot be classified as active external inputs or generated intermediates from the available safe view.

Each Stata entrypoint requires pathMAIN to resolve the packaged DATA tree and writable output directories. The authentication/configuration blocks that initialize it were masked as complete logical blocks, so the current value and host path semantics were not reviewed.

Step 3 saves location_SRAF.dta, while Step 6 reads location_sraf.dta. The package inventory contains the uppercase output and a distinct sec_location_sraf.dta, but no exact lowercase location_sraf.dta. A case-sensitive host needs a consistent working-copy path.

Step 2 constructs citation outcomes through ten years for the Step 4 1996-2005 cohort. The exact packaged patents and cites inputs are readable with the required identifiers, so their supplied routes are available. Bounded probes do not establish full date coverage, population or cutoff; this remains an empirical-fidelity validation limit, not evidence that an input is unavailable or that a shortfall exists.

review_notes: The full target retains all six Stata programs in the author datasheet order. Step 5 is supplied code; its full screened range remains withheld, so its inputs and distance construction stay unresolved without any absent-code or absent-producer inference.

Step 1 outputs indexes, and the exact packaged indexes.dta is readable with the fields consumed downstream; the data-description filename “python_indexes” is reconciled by the datasheet and source code naming indexes. The initial alias issue has been removed.

Confirmed visible chains are Step 1 indexes -> Steps 3/6; Step 2 forward_citations_collapsed -> Step 4; Step 3 annual_cleaned -> Step 4; Step 3 location_SRAF -> Step 6 location_sraf (case mismatch); and Step 5 distance_to_DOJ -> Step 6 (consumer fields are visible, producer contract is not). See probes/workflow_trace_v1.json.
A separate Step 4 analysis_only target is supported by four packaged readable author-prepared inputs and the supplied patent-level program. It does not claim full-pipeline completion.

Compustat is present as the exact author file and has a successful bounded metadata probe. The frozen catalog also lists COMP.FUNDA at ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat, but this is a metadata candidate only and was not probed or started through SAS.

SEC filings are publicly searchable. The current SRAF header product page covers a 1993-2025 product, but its schema and coverage are not verified as a drop-in for the author’s packaged 1993-2021 header file; output_4 text features are not reconstructed from public filings.

Stata 18 is available. The visible Stata variable abbreviations are supported by Stata 18’s default varabbrev setting; Step 2’s legacy set memory line is ignored by Stata 12 and later. No Stata or author program was executed.

One-row metadata probes establish readability and sampled fields, not complete population or history. Package logs, raw configuration/authentication text and the entire Step 5 implementation remain opaque.
